source-parity.source: GOB 143 adds +50 to sitting Health Regen stat 526 and grants 1060. Retail ProxyM2_m2_packets6 lines 69362 and 69380–69384 show the six independent temporary 671 records on /sit, including +300 HP regen and +200 IS regen.
source-parity.runtime: The ordinary stance installs and removes source 671. Out-of-combat health recovery independently adds the current 143/526 contribution. Unloading 143 while seated leaves 671 and IS recovery active, and drops the 1060 grant.
source-parity.test: PR737 verifies the five stock steps at level 19. HP ticks are +40/+180/+160/+180/+40 and IS ticks are +8/+24/+24/+24/+8 per two seconds. Native loadout records prove 526 and 1060 remove and return while seated, and /stand removes all six 671 records. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/737#issuecomment-7075295446
